### Given Data:
* Weight of each cylinder ($W$) = $100\text{ N}$
* Diameter of each cylinder ($d$) = $80\text{ mm} \implies$ Radius ($r$) = $40\text{ mm}$
* Width of the channel ($B$) = $180\text{ mm}$

---

### Geometry of Centers:
* Let the centers of cylinders be $A$, $B$, and $C$.
* Distance from the vertical wall to the center of cylinder $B$ or $C$ = Radius = $40\text{ mm}$.
* Distance between centers of $B$ and $C$ horizontally = Width - (Radius of B + Radius of C) = $180 - (40 + 40) = 100\text{ mm}$.
* The line joining centers $A$ and $B$ has a length of $r_A + r_B = 40 + 40 = 80\text{ mm}$.
* Horizontal distance between centers $A$ and $B$ = $\frac{100}{2} = 50\text{ mm}$.
* Let $\theta$ be the angle the line of centers $AB$ makes with the horizontal:
  $$\cos\theta = \frac{50}{80} = 0.625 \implies \theta = 51.32^\circ$$

---

### Free Body Diagram Analysis:

**1. Equilibrium of Cylinder A:**
Forces acting on A: Weight downwards ($100\text{ N}$), reaction from cylinder B ($R_{AB}$) along the line of centers, and reaction from cylinder C ($R_{AC}$) along the line of centers.
Due to symmetry, $R_{AB} = R_{AC}$.
$$\sum F_y = 0 \implies 2 R_{AB} \sin\theta - W = 0$$
$$2 R_{AB} \sin(51.32^\circ) = 100 \implies R_{AB} = \frac{100}{2 \times 0.7808} = 64.04\text{ N}$$  
*(i) Pressure/reaction exerted by cylinder A on B = $64.04\text{ N}$.*

**2. Equilibrium of Cylinder B:**
Forces acting on B: Weight downwards ($100\text{ N}$), reaction from cylinder A ($R_{BA} = R_{AB} = 64.04\text{ N}$ at angle $\theta$ to horizontal), normal reaction from base ($R_1$), and normal reaction from left wall ($R_2$).
* **Horizontal Equilibrium ($\sum F_x = 0$):**
  $$R_2 - R_{BA} \cos\theta = 0$$
  $$R_2 = 64.04 \cos(51.32^\circ) = 64.04 \times 0.625 = 40.03\text{ N}$$  
  *(iii) Pressure exerted by cylinder B on the wall = $40.03\text{ N}$.*

* **Vertical Equilibrium ($\sum F_y = 0$):**
  $$R_1 - W - R_{BA} \sin\theta = 0$$
  $$R_1 = 100 + 64.04 \sin(51.32^\circ) = 100 + 64.04 \times 0.7808 = 150.0\text{ N}$$
  *(ii) Pressure exerted by cylinder B on the base = $150.0\text{ N}$.*
